rows.label: tlk70000033_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Since the attack, all kinds of things
are still in short supply everywhere,
and people are struggling, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_02_msg0002
rows.name:
So Momimi arranged for the Pignerator
Trade Guild to send relief supplies
for free, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Surprised a merchant would do that,
mo? 'When in trouble, rely on Samo' is
one of Momimi's family sayings, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_02_msg0004
rows.name:
The meaning? Momimi doesn't really
know either, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_02_msg0005
rows.name:
But surely it means that when someone
is in trouble, everyone should help
each other, mo!
